blocks.zh: 注射劑與眼用製劑之包裝送審要求（含 Table 3, 4, 5）
blocks.en: Packaging Submission Requirements for Injectable and Ophthalmic Products (including Tables 3, 4 and 5)

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 掌握 Table 3 — 任何藥品原始申請案的包裝送審資訊清單
blocks.en: Master Table 3: the list of packaging information to submit for any original drug application

blocks.zh: 理解注射劑 CCS 的特殊風險：hemolytic effects、pyrogenic effects、potency loss、extractant concerns
blocks.en: Understand the special risks of the injectable CCS: hemolytic effects, pyrogenic effects, potency loss and extractant concerns

blocks.zh: 掌握 Table 4 — 注射劑/眼用製劑的 suitability、safety、compatibility 及 QC 要求
blocks.en: Master Table 4: the suitability, safety, compatibility and QC requirements for injectable/ophthalmic products

blocks.zh: 瞭解 SVP 與 LVP 的包裝材料差異及其 qualification 要求
blocks.en: Understand how the packaging materials of SVPs and LVPs differ and the qualification requirements for each

blocks.zh: 理解眼用製劑的 AAO 色碼系統 (Table 5) 及其與包裝選擇的關聯
blocks.en: Understand the AAO color-coding system for ophthalmic products (Table 5) and its relevance to packaging selection

blocks.en: Master the solvent selection strategy for extraction studies: water vs. the drug product vehicle

blocks.zh: III.C. Information for Original Application Submissions 原始申請案送審資訊
blocks.en: III.C. Information for Original Application Submissions

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: Description 三要素:
blocks.en: The three elements of the description:

blocks.zh: 1. Component identification: 產品名、代碼、製造商名稱地址、物理描述
blocks.en: 1. Component identification: Product name, code, manufacturer name and address, physical description

blocks.zh: 2. Materials of construction: 具體產品代碼 + 製造商——不能只寫「glass vial」，要寫「Type I borosilicate glass vial, Manufacturer X, Product Code Y」
blocks.en: 2. Materials of construction: Specific product code + manufacturer: it is not enough to write "glass vial"; write "Type I borosilicate glass vial, Manufacturer X, Product Code Y"

blocks.zh: 3. Post-manufacture treatments: 清洗、塗覆、滅菌、去熱原等操作的描述
blocks.en: 3. Post-manufacture treatments: A description of operations such as cleaning, coating, sterilization and depyrogenation

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: Description 就像建築設計的材料規格表——不能只寫「用鋼筋水泥」，要精確到「使用 XX 牌 #4 鋼筋 (fy=4200 kg/cm²)、XX 牌 Type I Portland Cement」。包裝組件的描述也是如此——精確到供應商、產品代碼、材料等級。
blocks.en: The description is like the material specification sheet of a building design: it is not enough to write "reinforced concrete"; it must be precise down to "XX brand #4 rebar (fy=4200 kg/cm²), XX brand Type I Portland Cement". The same applies to the description of packaging components: precise down to the supplier, product code and material grade.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: Postconsumer recycled plastic 禁令：不得用於 primary packaging components。即使用於 secondary 或 associated components，也須評估安全性和相容性。這反映了回收塑膠中可能殘留的未知化學物質對藥品品質的風險。
blocks.en: Ban on postconsumer recycled plastic: It must not be used in primary packaging components. Even when used in secondary or associated components, its safety and compatibility must be evaluated. This reflects the risk to drug product quality from unknown chemicals that may remain in recycled plastic.

blocks.zh: Alternate materials of construction：如果申請案中計劃使用替代材料，應在初始申請中一併提出。事後變更需要 supplement。
blocks.en: Alternate materials of construction: If the application plans to use alternate materials, they should be proposed together in the initial application. A later change requires a supplement.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: CDMO 在為注射劑準備 CCS description 時，通常需要列出哪些組件？請為一個標準的 20mL vial 產品列出完整清單。
blocks.en: When preparing the CCS description for an injectable, which components does a CDMO typically need to list? Provide the complete list for a standard 20 mL vial product.

blocks.zh: Suitability 測試的分工模式:
blocks.en: Division of labor in suitability testing:

blocks.zh: 這明確了 CDMO 和供應商各自的責任範圍。
blocks.en: This makes clear the respective areas of responsibility of the CDMO and the supplier.

blocks.zh: CCS qualification 的分工就像蓋房子——建材供應商 (packaging component manufacturer) 負責證明每塊磚、每根鋼筋的品質（via DMF）；建築師/營造商 (applicant/CDMO) 負責證明組裝後的房子整體結構安全（assembled system testing）。兩者缺一不可。
blocks.en: The division of labor in CCS qualification is like building a house: the building material supplier (packaging component manufacturer) is responsible for proving the quality of every brick and every steel bar (via DMF); the architect/contractor (applicant/CDMO) is responsible for proving that the assembled house is structurally sound as a whole (assembled system testing). Neither can be dispensed with.

blocks.zh: COA/COC 接收的限制：21 CFR 211.84(d)(3) 允許基於供應商 COA/COC + identification test 接收包裝組件。但 FDA 提醒這「may not be appropriate in all cases」——特別是吸入劑的某些組件。對注射劑 CDMO，建議在 COA 接收的基礎上增加定期的驗證性全測試。
blocks.en: Limits on accepting by COA/COC: 21 CFR 211.84(d)(3) permits acceptance of packaging components on the basis of the supplier's COA/COC + an identification test. But FDA cautions that this "may not be appropriate in all cases", particularly for certain components of inhalation products. For an injectable CDMO, it is advisable to add periodic confirmatory full testing on top of COA-based acceptance.

blocks.zh: 穩定性試驗中的 CCS 監控：穩定性試驗不僅要監控藥品本身，還要監控包裝系統的任何變化。即使沒有正式的包裝測試項目，觀察到的任何包裝變化都須調查。
blocks.en: CCS monitoring in stability studies: A stability study should monitor not only the drug product itself but also any change in the packaging system. Even where there is no formal packaging test item, any change observed in the packaging must be investigated.

blocks.zh: III.C.3.a/b/c — QC 三方責任鏈 Key Concepts
blocks.en: III.C.3.a/b/c - The QC Chain of Responsibility Key Concepts

blocks.zh: 三層 QC 責任結構：
blocks.en: Three-tier QC responsibility structure:

blocks.zh: 1. Applicant (III.C.3.a): 定義接收測試方法、COA/COC 驗證程序、dimensional/performance 標準、extractables acceptance criteria。CDMO 作為 applicant 的受託方，通常需執行這些職責。
blocks.en: 1. Applicant (III.C.3.a): Defines the incoming test methods, the COA/COC verification procedure, the dimensional/performance standards and the extractables acceptance criteria. A CDMO, as the applicant's contractor, usually has to carry out these duties.

blocks.zh: 2. Component Manufacturer (III.C.3.b): 提供 release criteria、製程描述、statistical process control (SPC) 驗證。這些資訊通常透過 Type III DMF 提供。
blocks.en: 2. Component Manufacturer (III.C.3.b): Provides release criteria, a process description and statistical process control (SPC) validation. This information is usually provided through a Type III DMF.

blocks.zh: 3. Materials/Intermediate Manufacturer (III.C.3.c): 供應鏈上游的 QC——原料或中間組件製造商的品質控制。當 packaging component manufacturer 的 QC 依賴上游供應商時，整條鏈的每個貢獻者都須描述其 QC 措施。
blocks.en: 3. Materials/Intermediate Manufacturer (III.C.3.c): Upstream QC in the supply chain: the quality control of the manufacturers of raw materials or intermediate components. When the packaging component manufacturer's QC depends on upstream suppliers, every contributor along the chain must describe its QC measures.

blocks.zh: 供應商變更通報義務 Key Notes
blocks.en: Supplier Change Notification Obligations Key Notes

blocks.zh: Change Notification Chain (變更通報鏈): 原料供應商 → packaging component manufacturer → drug product manufacturer → FDA (via 21 CFR 314.70(a) or 601.12)。任何原料或中間組件的配方或製程變更都應向下游客戶通報，並更新相關 DMF。看似無害的變更可能對成品劑型產生意想不到的後果。
blocks.en: Change Notification Chain: raw material supplier → packaging component manufacturer → drug product manufacturer → FDA (via 21 CFR 314.70(a) or 601.12). Any change in the formulation or process of a raw material or intermediate component should be notified to downstream customers and the relevant DMF updated. A change that seems innocuous may have unintended consequences for the finished dosage form.

blocks.zh: SPC 的特殊要求：若 packaging component 的放行基於 statistical process control 而非逐批測試，必須提供完整的 SPC 流程描述（含 control criteria）及其驗證。這在高產量組件（如 vial caps、stoppers）中常見。
blocks.en: Special requirements for SPC: If the release of a packaging component is based on statistical process control rather than batch-by-batch testing, a complete description of the SPC process (including control criteria) and its validation must be provided. This is common for high-volume components (such as vial caps and stoppers).

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: CDMO 的穩定性試驗 protocol 應包含 CCS 監控項目：(1) 外觀檢查（容器/密封件的變色、脆化、沉積物）；(2) 容器完整性測試 (CCIT)；(3) extractables/leachables trending；(4) headspace gas analysis（若適用）。這些數據不僅支持穩定性報告，也是 CCS 持續適用性的證據。
blocks.en: A CDMO's stability study protocol should include CCS monitoring items: (1) visual inspection (discoloration, embrittlement and deposits on the container/closure); (2) container closure integrity testing (CCIT); (3) extractables/leachables trending; (4) headspace gas analysis (if applicable). These data not only support the stability report but also serve as evidence of the continued suitability of the CCS.

blocks.zh: 供應商管理 SOP 要求：CDMO 應建立包裝組件供應商變更通報的 SOP，明確要求供應商在變更 formulation 或 manufacturing process 前通知 CDMO。此要求應納入 Quality Agreement 中，確保供應鏈的 traceability。
blocks.en: Supplier management SOP requirements: A CDMO should establish an SOP for packaging component supplier change notification, explicitly requiring suppliers to notify the CDMO before changing the formulation or manufacturing process. This requirement should be written into the Quality Agreement to ensure traceability across the supply chain.

blocks.zh: 為什麼 assembled CCS 測試通常由 applicant 而非供應商執行？這與「整體大於部分之和」的概念有何關聯？
blocks.en: Why is testing of the assembled CCS usually performed by the applicant rather than the supplier? How does this relate to the idea that "the whole is greater than the sum of its parts"?

blocks.zh: 如果穩定性試驗中發現 stopper 表面出現白色沉積物，CDMO 應如何調查並判定是否需要提交 supplement？
blocks.en: If a white deposit appears on the stopper surface in a stability study, how should the CDMO investigate and decide whether a supplement must be submitted?

blocks.zh: 一家 stopper 供應商更換了 mold release agent。依據 III.C.3.b 和 III.C.3.c 的要求，這個變更應如何在供應鏈中傳達？CDMO 應採取哪些行動？
blocks.en: A stopper supplier has changed its mold release agent. Under the requirements of III.C.3.b and III.C.3.c, how should this change be communicated along the supply chain? What actions should the CDMO take?

blocks.zh: 圖表解讀 Table Analysis
blocks.en: Table Analysis

blocks.zh: Table 3 是所有藥品通用的 CCS 送審清單。此表結構對應 III.C 的四大區塊：Description → Suitability (Protection + Safety + Compatibility + Performance) → QC → Stability。
blocks.en: Table 3 is the CCS submission checklist common to all drug products. Its structure follows the four blocks of III.C: Description → Suitability (Protection + Safety + Compatibility + Performance) → QC → Stability.

blocks.zh: 關鍵腳註：
blocks.en: Key footnotes:

blocks.zh: <sup>b</sup> 塑膠測試必須在「成型後的組件」上進行，不是未成型的 resin。Blow/Fill/Seal (BFS) 產品須在「formed container」上測試——因為成型過程可能引入新的 extractables。
blocks.en: <sup>b</sup> Plastic tests must be performed on the "formed component", not on the unformed resin. For blow/fill/seal (BFS) products, testing must be done on the "formed container", because the forming process may introduce new extractables.

blocks.zh: QC 責任分兩層：Applicant (incoming tests + dimensional criteria) 和 Supplier (release criteria + manufacturing process description)
blocks.en: QC responsibility is split into two tiers: the Applicant (incoming tests + dimensional criteria) and the Supplier (release criteria + manufacturing process description)

blocks.zh: CDMO 應將 Table 3 作為 CCS 送審文件的 master checklist。建議建立標準化的 CCS dossier template，依據 Table 3 的結構編排。對 BFS 產品特別注意：extractables 須在成型容器上測試，且 BFS 製程的溫度和接觸時間可能影響 extractable profile——需要 process-specific 的數據。
blocks.en: A CDMO should use Table 3 as the master checklist for the CCS submission documents. It is advisable to establish a standardized CCS dossier template organized according to the structure of Table 3. For BFS products, take particular care: extractables must be tested on the formed container, and the temperature and contact time of the BFS process may affect the extractable profile, so process-specific data are needed.

blocks.zh: III.D. Inhalation Drug Products 吸入劑
blocks.en: III.D. Inhalation Drug Products

blocks.zh: 吸入劑的特殊地位：吸入劑在 Table 1 中位於「Highest concern」，Table 2 中安全性為 Case 1s（最嚴格——需要 batch-to-batch monitoring of extractables）。本指引將吸入劑的詳細 CCS 要求交由專門的 MDI/DPI guidance 處理。
blocks.en: The special status of inhalation products: Inhalation products sit at "highest concern" in Table 1, and in Table 2 their safety is Case 1s (most stringent: batch-to-batch monitoring of extractables is required). This guidance leaves the detailed CCS requirements for inhalation products to the dedicated MDI/DPI guidance.

blocks.zh: 吸入劑對包裝的敏感度就像過敏體質的人對環境的敏感度——呼吸道已受損的病人吸入任何從包裝遷移出的物質，風險都比注射劑更直接。包裝組件中的微量揮發物可能直接刺激氣道。
blocks.en: The sensitivity of inhalation products to packaging is like the sensitivity of an allergic person to the environment: for a patient whose airways are already compromised, anything inhaled that has migrated from the packaging carries a more direct risk than with an injectable. Trace volatiles from packaging components may directly irritate the airways.

blocks.zh: 雖然無菌 CDMO 不常處理 MDI/DPI 產品，但 nebulizer solutions (吸入溶液) 可能屬於無菌製造範疇。此類產品的 CCS 要求是所有劑型中最嚴格的——包括 batch-to-batch extraction monitoring。
blocks.en: Although a sterile CDMO does not often handle MDI/DPI products, nebulizer solutions (inhalation solutions) may fall within sterile manufacturing. The CCS requirements for such products are the most stringent of all dosage forms, including batch-to-batch extraction monitoring.

blocks.zh: 為什麼吸入劑的 CCS safety 要求 (Case 1s) 比注射劑 (Case 2s) 更嚴格？從暴露途徑和病人族群的角度分析。
blocks.en: Why are the CCS safety requirements for inhalation products (Case 1s) stricter than for injectables (Case 2s)? Analyze from the standpoint of route of exposure and patient population.

blocks.zh: III.E. Drug Products for Injection and Ophthalmic Drug Products III.E. 注射用藥品與眼用藥品
blocks.en: III.E. Drug Products for Injection and Ophthalmic Drug Products

blocks.zh: 注射劑的最高風險特性：任何因包裝引入的污染物都可能「rapidly and completely」進入全身循環。這就是為什麼注射劑位於 Table 1 的最高風險位置。
blocks.en: The highest-risk nature of injectables: Any contaminant introduced by the packaging can enter the systemic circulation "rapidly and completely". This is why injectables occupy the highest-risk position in Table 1.

blocks.zh: SVP vs LVP: Small-Volume Parenteral (≤100 mL) vs Large-Volume Parenteral (>100 mL)。SVP 包裝選項：cartridge, syringe, vial, ampule, flexible bag；LVP 選項：vial, flexible bag, glass bottle, syringe。
blocks.en: SVP vs LVP: Small-volume parenteral (≤100 mL) vs large-volume parenteral (>100 mL). SVP packaging options: cartridge, syringe, vial, ampule, flexible bag; LVP options: vial, flexible bag, glass bottle, syringe.

blocks.zh: 四大交互作用風險：
blocks.en: The four main interaction risks:

blocks.zh: Hemolytic effects (溶血效應) — 因滲透壓改變（溶劑損失導致張力變化）
blocks.en: Hemolytic effects: due to a change in osmolality (solvent loss alters tonicity)

blocks.zh: Pyrogenic effects (致熱效應) — 因包裝組件引入的雜質
blocks.en: Pyrogenic effects: due to impurities introduced by packaging components

blocks.zh: Potency loss (效價損失) — 因 adsorption/absorption
blocks.en: Potency loss: due to adsorption/absorption

blocks.zh: Extractable contamination — 共溶劑系統可作為強力萃取劑
blocks.en: Extractable contamination: cosolvent systems can act as powerful extractants

blocks.zh: 注射劑的包裝風險就像直接把食物注入血管——口服至少還有腸胃道的「第一道防線」(first-pass effect)，但注射劑完全繞過了所有天然屏障。包裝中溶出的微量物質如果經口服可能無害，但直接注射就可能引起溶血或發熱反應。Prefilled syringe 的多材料結構（plastic + glass + rubber + metal）就像一道多材料的「化學雷區」——每種材料都可能是 extractables 的來源。
blocks.en: The packaging risk of an injectable is like injecting food straight into the bloodstream: with oral administration there is at least the "first line of defense" of the gastrointestinal tract (first-pass effect), but an injectable bypasses all natural barriers. Trace substances leached from the packaging might be harmless if taken orally but could cause hemolysis or fever if injected directly. The multi-material construction of a prefilled syringe (plastic + glass + rubber + metal) is like a multi-material "chemical minefield": every material can be a source of extractables.

blocks.zh: Extraction study 溶劑策略（極重要）：
blocks.en: Solvent strategy for extraction studies (extremely important):

blocks.zh: 首選：使用 drug product 本身作為萃取介質
blocks.en: First choice: use the drug product itself as the extraction medium

blocks.zh: 若藥品的萃取特性可能與水不同（高/低 pH、含 solubilizing excipient）→ 必須用 drug product
blocks.en: If the extraction characteristics of the drug product may differ from those of water (high/low pH, solubilizing excipients) → the drug product must be used

blocks.zh: 若 drug substance 顯著影響萃取 → 可使用 drug product vehicle（不含 API 的 placebo）
blocks.en: If the drug substance significantly affects extraction → the drug product vehicle (placebo without API) may be used

blocks.zh: 若總萃取物顯著超過水萃取的量 → 必須獲取 extraction profile
blocks.en: If total extractables significantly exceed the amount extracted by water → an extraction profile must be obtained

blocks.zh: 這個「升級梯度」是 FDA 對注射劑 extraction study 的核心策略。CDMO 在設計 E&L 研究時必須遵循。
blocks.en: This "escalation gradient" is FDA's core strategy for extraction studies on injectables. A CDMO must follow it when designing E&L studies.

blocks.zh: Glass 的特殊情形：通常 USP Glass Containers 測試即可。但含螯合劑的藥品可能從玻璃中萃取出金屬離子——需要額外的相容性評估。
blocks.en: The special case of glass: The USP Glass Containers test is usually sufficient. But drug products containing chelating agents may extract metal ions from the glass, so an additional compatibility assessment is needed.

blocks.zh: CDMO 的 extraction study 設計 checklist：
blocks.en: A CDMO's extraction study design checklist:

blocks.zh: 確認產品配方的 pH 和共溶劑組成 — 判斷是否需要用 drug product/vehicle 做萃取
blocks.en: Confirm the pH and cosolvent composition of the product formulation to determine whether extraction with the drug product/vehicle is needed

blocks.zh: 對 elastomeric stoppers：USP <381> + extraction profile (建議用 drug product vehicle)
blocks.en: For elastomeric stoppers: USP <381> + extraction profile (drug product vehicle recommended)

blocks.zh: 對 plastic components：USP <87>/<88> + 必要時的 extraction profile
blocks.en: For plastic components: USP <87>/<88> + an extraction profile where necessary

blocks.zh: 對 glass vials：USP <660> Chemical Resistance + 如含 chelating agents 則需額外評估
blocks.en: For glass vials: USP <660> Chemical Resistance + additional assessment if chelating agents are present

blocks.zh: 建立 extraction profile baseline 並定期（至少年度）與新批次比較
blocks.en: Establish an extraction profile baseline and compare new batches against it periodically (at least annually)

blocks.zh: 含 polysorbate 80 (0.02%) 的 mAb 注射劑，extraction study 應使用水、placebo vehicle、還是 drug product 作為萃取介質？為什麼？
blocks.en: For a mAb injectable containing polysorbate 80 (0.02%), should the extraction study use water, the placebo vehicle or the drug product as the extraction medium? Why?

blocks.zh: Prefilled syringe 的 silicone oil 潤滑層為何是 extractables/leachables 研究中的特殊挑戰？
blocks.en: Why is the silicone oil lubricant layer of a prefilled syringe a particular challenge in extractables/leachables studies?

blocks.zh: 為什麼 multicomponent construction (如 prefilled syringe) 的交互作用風險比單一材料容器更高？
blocks.en: Why is the interaction risk higher for multicomponent construction (such as a prefilled syringe) than for a single-material container?

blocks.zh: Table 4 vs Table 3 的關鍵差異（Injectable/Ophthalmic 額外要求）：
blocks.en: Key differences of Table 4 vs Table 3 (additional requirements for injectable/ophthalmic products):

blocks.zh: Safety: 具體指定了 USP <381> (elastomers), USP Glass Containers (glass), USP Biological Reactivity (plastics)；加入 121°C/1 hr extraction profile 要求（heat sterilization 後的加速萃取）
blocks.en: Safety: Specifies USP <381> (elastomers), USP Glass Containers (glass) and USP Biological Reactivity (plastics); adds a 121°C/1 hr extraction profile requirement (accelerated extraction after heat sterilization)

blocks.zh: Compatibility: 新增 swelling effects (elastomers), particulate matter + eye irritants (ophthalmics), coating integrity (metal tubes)
blocks.en: Compatibility: Adds swelling effects (elastomers), particulate matter + eye irritants (ophthalmics) and coating integrity (metal tubes)

blocks.zh: QC: 特別建議 periodic comparison to original extraction profile——這在 Table 3 的通用要求中未明確提及
blocks.en: QC: Specifically recommends periodic comparison to the original extraction profile: this is not explicitly mentioned in the general requirements of Table 3

blocks.zh: Supplier info: 要求描述 sterilization and depyrogenation 的程序和驗證
blocks.en: Supplier info: Requires a description of the sterilization and depyrogenation procedures and their validation

blocks.zh: 121°C/1 hour extraction: 對經高壓蒸汽滅菌的 plastic/elastomeric 組件，FDA 要求在 121°C/1 小時條件下用適當溶劑獲取 extraction profile。這遠比 USP 標準萃取條件 (70°C/24h) 嚴格，反映了滅菌製程對材料 extractable profile 的實際影響。
blocks.en: 121°C/1 hour extraction: For plastic/elastomeric components sterilized by autoclave, FDA requires an extraction profile obtained with an appropriate solvent at 121°C for 1 hour. This is far more stringent than the standard USP extraction conditions (70°C/24h), reflecting the real effect of the sterilization process on the extractable profile of the material.

blocks.zh: CDMO 應將 Table 4 作為注射劑 CCS dossier 的核心模板。注意：如果使用 RTU (Ready-to-Use) 預滅菌組件，滅菌製程由供應商執行——但驗證文件仍須納入申請案（via DMF）。Gamma 照射滅菌的 polymer 組件可能產生不同於 steam sterilization 的 extractable profile——選擇滅菌方式時須考慮此因素。
blocks.en: A CDMO should use Table 4 as the core template for an injectable CCS dossier. Note: if RTU (ready-to-use) presterilized components are used, the sterilization process is performed by the supplier, but the validation documents must still be included in the application (via DMF). Polymer components sterilized by gamma irradiation may have a different extractable profile from those sterilized by steam, so this factor must be considered when choosing the sterilization method.

blocks.zh: III.E.2. Ophthalmic Drug Products 眼用製劑
blocks.en: III.E.2. Ophthalmic Drug Products

blocks.zh: 眼用製劑 = 無菌 + 注射劑等級的 CCS 要求：雖然是外用，但因為 (1) 必須無菌 (21 CFR 200.50(a)(2))；(2) 直接接觸眼睛——需要額外考慮 eye irritation 和 particulate matter。
blocks.en: Ophthalmic products = sterile + injectable-grade CCS requirements: Although they are used topically, they must (1) be sterile (21 CFR 200.50(a)(2)) and (2) contact the eye directly, so eye irritation and particulate matter need additional consideration.

blocks.zh: AAO Color Coding: 瓶蓋和標籤的色碼系統，用於預防用藥錯誤。偏離標準須提供 adequate justification。
blocks.en: AAO Color Coding: A color-coding system for bottle caps and labels, used to prevent medication errors. Deviations from the standard require adequate justification.

blocks.zh: AAO 色碼系統就像電氣配線的色碼標準——紅色是火線、綠色是地線。眼科用藥的瓶蓋色碼讓藥師和病人能快速識別藥物類別，避免混淆。想像一個青光眼病人同時使用 beta-blocker (黃蓋) 和 prostaglandin analogue (藍綠蓋)——色碼差異幫助他區分不同的眼藥水。
blocks.en: The AAO color-coding system is like the color-code standard for electrical wiring: red is live and green is ground. The cap color codes for ophthalmic drugs let pharmacists and patients quickly identify the drug class and avoid confusion. Imagine a glaucoma patient using both a beta-blocker (yellow cap) and a prostaglandin analogue (blue-green cap): the color difference helps them tell the different eye drops apart.

blocks.zh: 眼用製劑的額外 compatibility/safety 要求：
blocks.en: Additional compatibility/safety requirements for ophthalmic products:

blocks.zh: Eye irritation potential：包裝溶出物是否會刺激眼睛
blocks.en: Eye irritation potential: whether the extractables from the packaging could irritate the eye

blocks.zh: Particulate matter：USP <771> Ophthalmic Ointments 標準
blocks.en: Particulate matter: USP <771> Ophthalmic Ointments standard

blocks.zh: LDPE dropper tip 的 extractables：長期接觸藥液的 dropper 組件
blocks.en: Extractables from the LDPE dropper tip: dropper components in long-term contact with the drug solution

blocks.zh: FDA 提到某些眼用溶液因為 plastic 的穩定性問題而改用 glass container——這說明材料選擇有時需要在 stability 和 safety 之間權衡。
blocks.en: FDA mentions that some ophthalmic solutions were switched to glass containers because of plastic stability problems; this shows that material selection sometimes requires a trade-off between stability and safety.

blocks.zh: Table 5 的實務意義：CDMO 為眼用製劑客戶選擇瓶蓋顏色時，必須查對 AAO 色碼表。若因產品特殊需求（如多劑量瓶需要 child-resistant cap 且無法取得 Pantone 色碼匹配的蓋子），須在 CMC 文件中說明偏離理由。
blocks.en: Practical significance of Table 5: When a CDMO selects cap colors for an ophthalmic client, it must check the AAO color-code table. If a product has special needs (for example, a multi-dose bottle needs a child-resistant cap and a cap matching the Pantone color code cannot be obtained), the reason for the deviation must be explained in the CMC documents.

blocks.zh: CDMO 處理眼用製劑時的額外 CCS 考量：(1) LDPE droptainer 的 drop size consistency 是 drug delivery performance 的關鍵——須驗證 dropper tip 尺寸公差對滴量的影響；(2) Multi-dose ophthalmic products 需要 antimicrobial preservative effectiveness (USP <51>) 在開封後整個使用期間的穩定性數據；(3) 瓶蓋色碼須符合 AAO 標準。
blocks.en: Additional CCS considerations when a CDMO handles ophthalmic products: (1) drop size consistency of an LDPE droptainer is the key to drug delivery performance, so the effect of dropper tip dimensional tolerances on drop volume must be verified; (2) multi-dose ophthalmic products need stability data on antimicrobial preservative effectiveness (USP <51>) throughout the whole in-use period after opening; (3) cap color codes must conform to the AAO standard.

blocks.zh: 眼用製劑為什麼被歸類於 Injectable 章節而非 Topical 章節？這對 CCS 數據包的完整性有何影響？
blocks.en: Why are ophthalmic products classified under the Injectable section rather than the Topical section? How does this affect the completeness of the CCS data package?

blocks.zh: 如果客戶的眼用溶液配方含有防腐劑 (benzalkonium chloride)，CCS 相容性研究應特別注意什麼？
blocks.en: If a client's ophthalmic solution formulation contains a preservative (benzalkonium chloride), what should the CCS compatibility study pay particular attention to?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: Table 3 是所有藥品通用的 CCS 送審資訊清單，結構為 Description → Suitability → QC → Stability
blocks.en: Table 3 is the CCS submission information checklist common to all drug products, structured as Description → Suitability → QC → Stability

blocks.zh: Injectable drug products 位於 Table 1 的最高風險區——任何包裝引入的污染物直接進入全身循環
blocks.en: Injectable drug products sit in the highest-risk zone of Table 1: any contaminant introduced by the packaging enters the systemic circulation directly

blocks.zh: 注射劑的四大交互作用風險：hemolytic effects、pyrogenic effects、potency loss (adsorption/absorption)、extractable contamination
blocks.en: The four main interaction risks of injectables: hemolytic effects, pyrogenic effects, potency loss (adsorption/absorption), extractable contamination

blocks.zh: Extraction study 溶劑選擇梯度：water → drug product vehicle → drug product（根據配方萃取特性決定）
blocks.en: Solvent selection gradient for extraction studies: water → drug product vehicle → drug product (determined by the extraction characteristics of the formulation)

blocks.zh: Table 4 在 Table 3 基礎上增加了注射劑/眼用製劑特有的要求：121°C/1hr extraction、swelling evaluation、sterility/depyrogenation validation
blocks.en: Table 4 adds requirements specific to injectable/ophthalmic products on top of Table 3: 121°C/1hr extraction, swelling evaluation, sterility/depyrogenation validation

blocks.zh: 眼用製劑兼具 sterile + topical 特性，CCS 要求等同 injectable + 額外的 eye irritation 和 particulate matter 考量
blocks.en: Ophthalmic products combine sterile and topical characteristics: CCS requirements equal those of injectables, plus eye irritation and particulate matter considerations

blocks.zh: AAO 色碼系統 (Table 5) 是眼用製劑包裝設計的標準——偏離須 justify
blocks.en: The AAO color-coding system (Table 5) is the standard for ophthalmic packaging design: deviations must be justified
